channel.description: Latest articles from The Garden Island (thegardenisland.com)

item.title: KCC Culinary Arts students learn with award-winning chefs
item.description: For more than a dozen Kauai Community College students in the Garde Manger Culinary Arts class led by George Levendis, Wednesday marked the end of two days of instruction with award-winning Waikiki hotel Chef Dale Radomski and Charlie Matsuda, the executive sous chef at the Sheraton Kauai at Coconut Beach.

item.title: Bills aimed at legalizing recreational marijuana lack support
item.description: Two bills aimed at legalizing recreational marijuana — or even creating marijuana guardrails — are effectively dead, according to House Speaker Nadine Nakamura and Rep. David Tarnas, who has pushed for legalization for years.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Go carefully on military hub work
item.description: Some in Hawaii’s leadership are contemplating an opportunity to expand the state’s manufacturing sector, which should prompt careful thought and a community-wide discussion.

item.title: Legislative bills address costs of hike rescues in Hawaii
item.description: Several bills seeking to recover the costs of search and rescue for trespassing hikers have once again been introduced to the state Legislature this session.

item.title: Happy Camper for Friday, February 20, 2026
item.description: Chinese New Year happened Tuesday with the first new moon of 2026. The festivities and celebrations continue through March 2 when everything concludes with the Chinese Lantern Festival in those countries where the lunar new year is a significant event.

item.title: Military wants Hawaii to be a hub for Pacific arms manufacturing
item.description: As the U.S. military eyes China, it has big plans for arms manufacturing in the Pacific — and Hawaii sits at the center of its vision.

item.title: High prices forecast to lower Hawaii auto sales this year
item.description: Hawaii auto sales reaccelerated and rose 3.7% in 2025 after three straight down years, but that upward burst may be short-lived.

item.title: Mayor visits Kauai Community College students learning trades
item.description: Mayor Derek S.K. Kawakami joined other special guests for a visit to Kauai Community College’s Automotive Technology department on Wednesday.

item.title: Girl Scout’s cookier sales start Friday
item.description: LIHUE — Feb. 19 was recognized by the National Confectioners Association as National Chocolate Mint Day, and the Girl Scout’s Thin Mints were among the shipment of cookies that arrived at the Kauai Veterans Center with the help of Royal Hawaiian Movers.
